svg.aria-label: Returning Task allocates an object even when the answer is already known; ValueTask can carry the answer directly with no allocation
svg.text: GetPriceAsync("TEA-01"): THE PRICE IS ALREADY IN THE CACHE
A Task is a class. Even when the result is ready instantly, a Task object has to be created to carry it.
A ValueTask is a struct. When the answer is already known, it holds it directly: zero allocations.

g.text: When the price isn't cached, the ValueTask simply wraps a real Task, so nothing is lost.
The rules: await it exactly once, never twice or from two places. Need that? Call .AsTask().
Use it only for hot methods that usually finish instantly. Everywhere else, Task is simpler.
